caseNameFull: Wilkerson v. Barefoot, Judges of the Criminal Court of Appeals of Oklahoma
attorneys: Messrs. W. N. Redwine, W. J. Hulsey and Mrs. Lena Hulsey for petitioner.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the Criminal Court of Appeals of Oklahoma, and motion for leave to proceed further in forma pauperis, denied.
